recognize_zh: 肝臟切片左側門脈區內有大量增生的小膽管（ductular reaction），周圍纖維化並混有淋巴球等發炎細胞，部分膽管上皮內可見淋巴球；右側肝細胞相對保留、無明顯小葉壞死，配合免疫檢查點抑制劑用藥史，符合其誘發的膽管型肝損傷。
features: Portal/periportal area with numerous proliferating bile ductules lined by cuboidal epithelium (ductular reaction)
Loose fibroedematous stroma around ductules with a mixed infiltrate of lymphocytes and scattered other inflammatory cells
Some ductular epithelium shows reactive atypia with intraepithelial inflammatory cells
Adjacent hepatocyte plates on the right are relatively preserved without significant interface or confluent necrosis in this field
No granulomas, viral inclusions or neoplastic infiltrate evident
describe_en: Liver biopsy shows a portal tract with a prominent ductular reaction composed of numerous small bile ductules lined by cuboidal epithelium within a loose fibroedematous stroma. There is a mild mixed portal inflammatory infiltrate of lymphocytes with scattered other inflammatory cells, and several duct profiles show epithelial injury with intraepithelial inflammatory cells. The adjacent lobular parenchyma is relatively preserved without significant lobular hepatitis in this field. In a patient receiving immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, findings are consistent with checkpoint inhibitor-associated hepatitis with a cholangitic/bile duct injury pattern.

ddx.vs: PBC shows florid duct lesions with granulomatous destruction of medium-sized interlobular ducts, AMA positivity and a chronic course rather than acute onset after drug exposure.
Obstruction produces ductular reaction with portal edema, neutrophils and bile plugs, and is identified by imaging showing a dilated biliary tree.
AIH shows plasma cell-rich interface and lobular hepatitis with emperipolesis and rosettes rather than a predominantly bile duct-centered injury.

ddx.dx: Hepatic involvement by lymphoma or metastatic adenocarcinoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma forms dense monotonous atypical infiltrates and metastatic adenocarcinoma shows infiltrative atypical glands, unlike these regularly spaced reactive ductules in inflamed stroma.
